name: Yan-C-Bin

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Tempest Aura
traits.details: The aura is difficult terrain for enemies, and enemies in the aura cannot fly and do not benefit from lightning resistance or thunder resistance. Any enemy that ends its turn in the aura takes 20 damage.

traits.name: All-Around Vision
traits.details: Enemies can’t gain combat advantage by flanking Yan-C-Bin.

traits.name: Epic Recovery
traits.details: When Yan-C-Bin starts his turn, any dazing, immobilizing, restraining, slowing, or stunning effect on him ends.

traits.name: Flowing Form
traits.details: While squeezing, Yan-C-Bin moves at full speed rather than half speed, he doesn’t take the -5 penalty to attack rolls, and he doesn’t grant combat advantage for squeezing. Yan-C-Bin can’t be knocked prone, and he ignores difficult terrain.

traits.name: Unseen Wind
traits.details: Yan-C-Bin is invisible and takes half damage from all sources while he moves. While moving, he can’t be immobilized, restrained, slowed, or otherwise hindered or stopped from moving by any attack or effect.

auras.name: Tempest Aura
auras.details: The aura is difficult terrain for enemies, and enemies in the aura cannot fly and do not benefit from lightning resistance or thunder resistance. Any enemy that ends its turn in the aura takes 20 damage.

effect.description: Before making the attack, Yan-C-Bin can slide each creature adjacent to the target 1 square.

hit.description: damage, Yan-C-Bin slides the target up to 6 squares, and the target falls prone.

miss.description: Yan-C-Bin slides the target up to 3 squares.

effect.description: Yan-C-Bin moves up to his speed and can move through enemies’ spaces during the move. Each time he enters an enemy’s space for the first time during the move, he uses gale strike on that enemy, dealing 10 extra damage on a hit.

hit.description: lightning and thunder damage, and the target is stunned (save ends).

effect.description: Close burst 20; Yan-C-Bin creates four Medium whirlwind servants, each in a square within the burst. A servant occupies its square, and it has an aura identical to Yan-C-Bin’s tempest aura. Each servant lasts until Yan-C-Bin is bloodied. When he uses gale sweep, and as a minor action once per turn, Yan-C-Bin can move each servant up to 8 squares.

powers.name: Poison Wind
